body.heading: Where in the world is Nauru?
paragraphs: Nauru is a country in Micronesia, which is part of Oceania. It is an island country, surrounded by sea.

body.heading: A capital with a twist
paragraphs: Nauru is so small that it has no officially designated capital city at all — the only country in the world like it. The government offices stand in the Yaren District, on the island's southwest coast.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Nauru speak Nauruan and English.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Nauru is the Australian dollar.

body.heading: How big is Nauru?
paragraphs: Nauru covers about 21 square kilometres of land and inland water. It is the smallest country in Oceania.

body.heading: A fact to wow your friends
paragraphs: Nauru is the smallest island nation in the world, and the third-smallest country of all — only Vatican City and Monaco are smaller.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Buada Lagoon is Nauru's hidden heart — a peaceful freshwater lagoon ringed by palms and gardens in the middle of the island, where families picnic.
Anibare Bay is the island's prettiest beach, a curve of white sand and coral pinnacles where the Pacific rolls in — Nauru's favourite sunrise spot.
